en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide city street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with ornate facades. The right side features a long, prominent building with arched windows, balconies, and ground‑floor shops with awnings; horse‑drawn vehicles and pedestrians are faintly visible. The left side of the image fades into blank space. Printed text in Russian and Latin script at the top right identifies the view as a street scene in Omsk and specifies the street name.
